prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: TOUCHLINE football training people sprite atlas, matching existing polished 16-bit Brazilian isometric RPG pixel art. Create EXACTLY sixteen separate full-body characters in a strict even 4 columns x 4 rows transparent PNG sheet. Row-major order listed below. Crisp square pixels, dark outlines, restrained 3-tone shading, designed to read at 24x42 gameplay pixels. Natural small RPG proportions, head about 1/4 body height. High angle three-quarter isometric camera, see tops of heads and shoulders. Team uniforms are mustard yellow short sleeve football jerseys with navy cuffs, navy shorts, cream knee socks and dark boots. Varied Brazilian skin tones, hairstyles and physiques, mostly young adult men. No brands, writing, numbers or logos. Characters only: NO balls, benches, chairs, floors, shadows, labels, frames or scenery. Keep every head, limb and shoe fully inside its own cell with generous transparent gutters. True transparent alpha, no glow. Each sprite same anatomical scale. Directions refer to SCREEN directions: NE=up-right with back visible, SW=down-left with face visible, SE=down-right face visible, NW=up-left back visible.
Row1: 1 athlete running NE, left leg forward, short curly black hair and dark brown skin; 2 same athlete running NE opposite stride right leg forward; 3 athlete running SW left leg forward, tan skin short brown hair wearing blue training bib over mustard kit; 4 same bib athlete running SW opposite stride.
Row2: 1 mustard-kit athlete passing toward NE right foot extended, short black hair warm brown skin; 2 same athlete preparing to receive a pass from NE, balanced standing legs apart; 3 mustard-kit striker shooting toward SE right foot extended, tan skin short cropped hair; 4 same striker standing preparing a shot toward SE.
Row3: four DIFFERENT reserve players seated on an INVISIBLE bench facing SW, hands on thighs or relaxed, feet toward lower-left: 1 dark brown skin tightly curled hair; 2 medium tan skin short straight black hair; 3 light brown skin shaved head; 4 medium brown skin close beard and short hair. All wear mustard/navy training kits. Bent thighs and knees visibly seated, no chair or bench drawn.
Row4: 1 goalkeeper in muted green long-sleeved jersey, charcoal shorts, gloves, cream socks, ready crouch facing NW; 2 same goalkeeper reaching toward NW both gloves raised, feet planted; 3 coach in navy tracksuit standing facing SE holding a small clipboard; 4 mustard-kit athlete stretching with a side lunge facing SW, arms balanced.
No smooth vector illustration, no realistic photo, no soft gradients. Exact 4x4 layout, all16 assets isolated, no omissions.
